info.title: API.SH: Tripadvisor
info.description: The Tripadvisor API from API.SH: public Tripadvisor data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Tripadvisor things to do in a city
get.description:
Attractions and things to do in a city or region as Tripadvisor ranks them, 30 per page: name, id, page type, URL, rating, review count, short description, badges and labels, number of bookable experiences, coordinates and photo, with `raw`. `total`, the sort options and the available filters (types of attractions with their ids for `category`) come with the list. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripadvisor-attractions

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or region: a Tripadvisor geo id (187147), g187147, a Tripadvisor URL containing g<id>, or a place name (the first matching city or region is used; `location.resolved_from` echoes it).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Attraction type id from `available_filters` (e.g. 47 = sights and landmarks).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort id from `sorts` (default TRAVELER_FAVORITE_V2).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Site filter tokens from Tripadvisor list URLs, comma-separated (max 6), e.g. zft11292 (free things to do).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (30 per page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Tripadvisor market: com (default), co.uk, de, fr, it, es or in. Names, prices, currency and review translations follow the market.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every booking site's price for a hotel stay, as Tripadvisor's price comparison shows it once all sites have answered: site, nightly price, total for the stay, taxes and fees text, lowest-price flag, status (available, sold out) and the sites' notes (free cancellation, member rates). With no dates, the site's default dates are used.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripadvisor-hotel-prices

Hotels in a city or region as Tripadvisor lists them, 30 per page (plus sponsored listings): name, id, URL, rating, review count, ranking, accommodation type, award, price range, lowest price and the booking-site offers for the stay (provider, price, availability, free cancellation), highlighted amenities, AI summary, address, phone, coordinates, neighborhoods and photo, with `raw`. Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripadvisor-hotels

get.summary: Tripadvisor place details (hotel, restaurant or attraction)
get.description:
Details for any Tripadvisor hotel, restaurant or attraction (`type` says which): name, URL, rating and the count per star, sub-ratings, review count, review languages, ranking, address, coordinates, phone, email, breadcrumbs, description, AI review summary, review keywords, photo count and photos, and the latest reviews. Hotels add amenities (property, room features, room types), star rating, price range and the booking-site offers for the stay when check_in / check_out are given (`offers.complete` false when partners were still answering). Restaurants add cuisines, price level and range, diets, meal types, features, hours, menu and awards. `nearby` lists the hotels, restaurants and attractions around the place (name, distance, rating, review count, rank, position, photo, link) with the counts within the range, nearby transit stops, airports and neighborhoods. `raw` holds the page data. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripadvisor-place

parameters.description: Tripadvisor location id (d-number), e.g. 93437; or pass url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Tripadvisor hotel, restaurant or attraction URL (instead of id).

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Hotels: check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) for offers; with check_out.

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Hotels: check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Hotels: adults (default 2).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Hotels: rooms (default 1).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Tripadvisor market: com (default), co.uk, de, fr, it, es or in. Names, prices, currency and review translations follow the market.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of a hotel, restaurant or attraction: id, title, text, rating, language (and original language when machine translated), publish date, trip type, visit month, helpful votes, sub-ratings, photos, URL, author (name, username, profile, avatar, hometown, contributions) and the owner's response, with `raw`. Filters as on the site: language, rating, trip type, months of visit, and a word in the text. `total` counts the reviews matching the filters; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripadvisor-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Tripadvisor location id (d-number), e.g. 93437; or pass url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Tripadvisor place URL (instead of id; also sets type).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Kind of place: hotel (default with id), restaurant, attraction or attraction_product.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page (1-20, default 10).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review language, e.g. en, fr, de, zh-TW; all for every language. Default: the market's mix as on the site.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Star ratings to keep, comma-separated, e.g. 5 or 1,2.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recent (default), detailed, insightful or default (the site's order).

parameters.name: trip_type
parameters.description: Trip types, comma-separated: family, couples, solo, business, friends.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Months of visit, comma-separated numbers 1-12.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews mentioning this word or phrase.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Tripadvisor market: com (default), co.uk, de, fr, it, es or in. Names, prices, currency and review translations follow the market.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The suggestions of Tripadvisor's search box for a query: cities and regions, hotels, restaurants, attractions and tours, each with its Tripadvisor id (`location_id`, use it with /tripadvisor/v1/place, /reviews or as `location` of the list endpoints), kind, parent region, address, coordinates, URL and photo; plus query suggestions. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripadvisor-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to look for, e.g. eiffel tower, paris, hilton new york.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limit results: all (default), geos (cities and regions), hotels, restaurants or attractions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results to return (1-20, default 10).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Tripadvisor market: com (default), co.uk, de, fr, it, es or in. Names, prices, currency and review translations follow the market.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
